**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **Responsive clauses:** § 13 Term of Agreement (p0078) carries the auto-renewal mechanic — successive one-year renewals, exit on 30 days' written notice by either party. § 6 (p0047) is the only pricing-protection language and freezes Hosting Services costs only "for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement". No other renewal or uplift language exists in the document (searches for "renew", uplift/increase language returned nothing further).
- **Assessment:** Renewal term (12 months) and notice window (30 days) already sit at or above the preferred parameters, so those are not redlined. The failure is renewal pricing: after year one, TrueLink may reprice each renewal without limit, which breaches the fallback requirement of ≤5% increases.
- **Cure:** One short insertion after p0078 capping fee increases at 5% per renewal term — no rewrite of the renewal or notice mechanics, and no volunteering of the preferred CPI/3% cap or the 60-day reminder, which are noted only in the rationale.
